newsitem.title: FRANCE: Cr National buys remaining 11 pct of BFCE.
newsitem.headline: Cr National buys remaining 11 pct of BFCE.

text.p: Groupe Credit National said it had acquired 11.74 percent of Banque Francaise du Commerce Exterieur (BFCE), bringing its control to 100 percent.

It said in a statement it bought the remaining stake in BFCE from the Bank of France and Caisse Francaise de Developpement (CFD) for the same price paid for previous holdings. Credit National acquired a controlling 78 percent of BFCE in January by purchasing the stakes held by AGF and state institutions Caisse des Depots et Consignations and Credit Lyonnais. In August it purchased a further 11.2 percent in BFCE from the Bank of France for 493 million francs.
